summary: Defines the profile for Route Origin Authorizations. A ROA is a signed object proving that the holder of an address block has authorized a particular AS to originate routes for prefixes in that block. It is a standards-track document that was replaced by RFC 9582.

eli5.summary: A ROA is a signed permission slip saying "this network may announce this address block". This defines what goes in the slip. It was later replaced by RFC 9582.
